subject: Unforeseen electrical field condition: existing conduit conflicting with the new duct

messages.text: We de-energized the circuit and logged the existing conduit conflicting with the new duct routing at Lobby 101 in today's field log; this isn't reflected in Electrical Panel Schedule E-601. We would like this resolved ahead of the next work sequence. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is holding up work in this area. A response within three days would be appreciated.

Keep the circuit locked out at Lobby 101 -- we'll send a revised routing sketch for the existing conduit conflicting with the new duct routing once engineering signs off. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum.
